objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (19 November 2026) on UNIQUE-TABLE-20261119-001's direction 1. Its six rivals are legal as static arrangements but five stall and none is shown reachable. stop_rule: Two non-isomorphic reached arrangements with one table, or none within the stated bound; referee hand-off; report.
title: Do two arrangements the cheapest growth reaches share a bond-distance table with different states?
